svg.title: A client admitted for surgery reports a latex allergy. Which statements does the nurse include in teaching? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Latex allergy calls for a latex-free environment for the entire stay , and latex cross-reacts with banana, avocado, kiwi and chestnut, so those foods are worth asking about. Limiting precautions to the procedure is the tempting error, and premedicating does not make exposure safe — antihistamines never rescue an airway.
